third_party_evaluations.summary: Deploys, manages, and operates multi-account AWS workloads with IaC and containers.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Operating multi-account workloads with infrastructure as code fits an associate practitioner at the recorded one-year level; vendor authority does not remove the AWS portability limitation.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Multi-account workload operations with IaC and containers fit an associate cloud operator and the recorded one-year profile. Proctoring helps screen knowledge, but the AWS-only scope provides limited evidence of independent incident handling.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded IaC, containers and multi-account operations fit hands-on-domain knowledge at a one-year experience level. AWS-specific coverage and no explicit practical exam keep it at associate.
